target.title: fix(ui): explain replace-mode filtering in model picker
target.body:
Closes #104545

## What Problem This Solves

When `models.mode: "replace"` filters the model catalog, the Control UI showed the resulting models without explaining why other bundled or discovered models might be absent.

## Why This Change Was Made

Configured model-list responses now carry additive `catalogMode: "replace"` metadata. The chat model picker and Quick Settings use that metadata to explain that model settings are filtering the catalog, without claiming that every visible row was explicitly configured. Full-catalog (`view: "all"`) responses do not carry the hint metadata.

The picker action now opens the Models section directly at `/settings/ai-agents?section=models#config-section-models`.

## User Impact

Users can tell that local model settings are filtering the catalog and can navigate directly to the relevant settings instead of treating an absent model as an upstream support problem.

## Evidence

- Exact-head refresh: rebased onto `main` at `7efdd9d7060`; pushed head `a87422638c8`.
- Added a mixed configured/discovered gateway regression. Under replace mode, an explicit `vllm/*` configuration retains both the configured and discovered VLLM rows and returns `catalogMode: "replace"`.
- Focused Gateway and UI regressions: 6 files, 293 tests passed.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-methods/models.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/models.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-state.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-view.test.ts ui/src/pages/config/quick.test.ts`
- Targeted Chromium regression for the replace-mode explanation and Models deep link: 1 passed, 6 skipped.
  - `pnpm exec vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui/src/e2e/chat-composer-redesign.e2e.test.ts -t 'explains model filtering in replace mode'`
- The complete browser file ran 6 tests successfully; the unchanged current-`main` geometry assertion at line 165 failed because its poll callback returns an object to a numeric matcher.
- Regenerated and committed the Swift `ModelsListResult` protocol model for the additive field; `pnpm protocol:check` passed on the final head. The earlier branch-owned `checks-fast-bundled-protocol` failure is therefore fixed.
- Focused `oxfmt` and type-aware `oxlint` passed for all six source/test files changed by the review repair.
- `pnpm deadcode:exports` passed with the current repository baseline of 3367 after making `ModelCatalogResult` module-private.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed.
- The final locale diff changes only `ui/src/i18n/locales/en.ts`; generated non-English locale files remain on the repository workflow. The Control UI i18n job reports the expected fallback drift for contributor-added English keys.
- The current native i18n inventory failure and plugin-SDK wildcard budget failure both reproduce unchanged on exact base `7efdd9d7060`; neither is caused by this diff.
- Local Codex review of the code repair found no discrete regression in the catalog metadata or UI hint flow; later commits add only the deterministic generated Swift output and clean rebase changes.
- Exact-head desktop 1280x900 and mobile 393x852 renders were generated and visually inspected against the corrected sentence. Both show clean wrapping and no overlap; refreshed attachments will be posted in the review follow-up.

Before: the UI overclaimed that replace mode showed only models explicitly listed in Settings.

After: the picker and Quick Settings state, "Replace mode filters models according to your model settings," and link directly to the Models settings section.

AI-assisted: Codex was used to implement, test, and review this change. No agent transcript is attached.
